answer_1.quote: We evaluate Hypoformer with three standard machine translation tasks (IWSLT'14 De-En, WMT'16 En-Ro, and WMT'14 En-De) on Raspberry Pi ARM CPU and Intel CPU.

answer_2.quote: Hypoformer consistently outperforms recent lightweight stateof-the-art methods under various parameter scales and speed scales. Achieving similar performance on three tasks, Hypoformer can compress Transformer base model  2.9 ∼ 4.5×, and speedup it 1.9 ∼ 3.3× on Intel CPU and 1.8 ∼ 3.9× on Raspberry Pi ARM CPU. Notably, when the parameter scale is extremely low, Hypoformer achieves a 7.1 higher BLEU score and 1.27× speedup than Transformer on IWSLT'14 De-En task.
